name: renvoo-memory-system
description: Obsidian-compatible memory system with Pinecone archive and maintenance tooling.

scripts.site:build: npm run site:generate && vite build --config config/vite.site.config.mjs && node config/site-postbuild.mjs
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:generate && vite preview --config config/vite.site.config.mjs
scripts.memory:init: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js init
scripts.memory:ingest: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js ingest
scripts.memory:query: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js query
scripts.memory:lint: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js lint
scripts.memory:compact: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js compact
scripts.memory:status: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js status
